component.name: Nexia Client
component.summary: Independent desktop sync client for Nextcloud servers

description.p: Nexia Client is an unofficial, independent desktop application for servers running Nextcloud. It provides virtual file sync with on-demand hydration, two-way folder synchronization, event-driven server theming, and native desktop performance.

This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Nextcloud GmbH. “Nextcloud” is a registered trademark of Nextcloud GmbH, used here only to describe the servers this client connects to.
